axes.correctness: lineLimit(nil) plus fixedSize(horizontal:false,vertical:true) reserves all wrapped title lines under the HStack width while retaining fixed counter sizing, first-baseline alignment, the unchanged dynamic-type cap and existing combined accessibility semantics. Parent VStack permits a taller header.
axes.readability: Two local text-layout modifiers fix the demonstrated one-line truncation. Updated topBar and shared-header comments now describe wrapping rather than a forced single row.
axes.architecture: The change stays inside the canonical shared LessonHeader and introduces no parallel renderer, new dependency, state or conditional policy.
axes.security: No new external data flow, storage, permissions or executable inputs.
axes.performance: Ordinary finite localized-title text reflow; no new loops, timers, network operations or retained UI state.

tests_reviewed.meaningful_regression: The old lineLimit(1) implementation would keep the same narrow/wide height. The new tests compare actual UIHostingController sizing at1200 and240 points, cover French/Russian long names, both layout directions and normal/accessibility1 sizing, and retain a short-name compactness check. A full accessibility label is not used as a proxy for visible text.
tests_reviewed.limits: Height growth alone does not certify every string or whole-screen layout. The implementation explicitly permits unlimited lines, and actual post-change simulator screenshots remain needed.
